subject: Startups
title: Open Source Licensing Traps
description: Learn Open Source Licensing Traps in one minute.

hook.text: A startup built its product using GPL-licensed code. Now investors say all codebase might need to be open-sourced.

buildup.text: Open-source licenses vary wildly. MIT and Apache are permissive. GPL requires derivative works to also be open-source.

discovery.text: Many startups use open-source libraries without reading licenses. During due diligence, this creates serious legal risk.

twist.text: Redis, MongoDB, and Elastic changed their licenses to prevent cloud providers from profiting without contributing back.

climax.text: Audit your dependencies before fundraising. A single copyleft license buried in your stack can derail an investment.

punchline.text: Free software isn't always free of strings. Read the license.

quiz.question: What makes GPL different from MIT license?
options: GPL requires derivative works to be open-sourced too
MIT is more restrictive than GPL
